judge.notes:
All three refusal points from attempt 1 are fixed. (1) The sentence "Nothing is inferred silently" is gone; line 46 now states only that a vendor not in risk_by_vendor gets 'unknown', which ZD-48600 supports. (2) The receivables-wording claim was removed. FQ-1 now says "Agent judgement: in an AP context the vendor is the party being paid". That is still general domain knowledge rather than something a source states, but it is clearly marked as the agent's judgement and is used only to raise an ambiguity, so I accept it. (3) The risk-map quote is no longer presented as a product scope boundary. Line 39 says plainly that org.strategy_capability has no out-of-scope list (FQ-6) and quotes the risk map only as the source of the advisory tier.

Checked and supported:
- R-AP-12 and R-AP-14 wording, Q4 2026 and 'Owner: PM' (org.roadmap).
- The capability and strategy quotes (org.strategy_capability).
- The T2 tier quote, CR-1 to CR-7, OQ-1 to OQ-5, Q-1 to Q-5, the PROV-ACME-2026-11 dates and models, and the ZD-48510 not-grouped decision (feat.classification).
- The ticket quotes: 'more than 30 days past due', 'sorted by days descending then id', the thresholds > 30 and > 10, delay_days = (paid_date - due_date), the 'paid_date' reject reason, and 'unknown' risk (ZD-48600).
- The REG-LPR-2026-4.2 'more than 60 days' Late rule.
- D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050 and L-007 (MEMORY.md).
- The api:github GET-only limitation (record:brief).

The agent's own inventions are disclosed as such: the reason code FIT-Y-ROADMAP (FQ-5), the 'Yes' recommendation, and the fit judgements are all labelled agent judgement.

Against the workbook action and outcome: the output checks the entry against capability, roadmap and strategy, gives a Yes verdict with evidence and a reason code, and drafts the notification to PM and Leadership. It truthfully says no message was sent because no channel is set and the connector is GET-only. Only small overreaches remain: the 'described only in the override' claim and the plural 'reject reasons'.
